message.abstract: <jats:p>With an emphasis on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and other deep learning methods, this study offers a thorough analysis of the most recent developments in the detection of AI-generated images. Deepfakes and synthetic images are examples of AI-generated content that is becoming more and more common, making the need for strong and trustworthy detection systems imperative. This review addresses the technical difficulties in distinguishing artificial intelligence (AI)-generated photos from actual ones while examining a number of datasets, such as CIFAKE, Face Forensics++, and Celeb-DF. The uncontrolled dissemination of AI-generated material on digital networks raises significant ethical and security issues, which are also highlighted in the article. This review examines the most recent detection techniques and identifies areas that require further study, such as generalization issues, resilience to hostile attacks, and the necessity for real-time detection. By providing insights into how future research might enhance picture authentication systems and protect the integrity of digital media, the findings are anticipated to support ongoing advancements in digital forensics, cyber security, and the ethical application of Ai technology.</jats:p>
title: Harnessing The Power Of AI To Detect AI Generated Images
